scope: Vol.I–III · TFAM – Editor Choice; fills six unfinished atlas dossiers.

canon_sources.title: Vol.I - TFAM - Editor Choice
anchors: Marrakesh: Inverness 1704, Wallace captured and released Edward; Scottish clan cohesion; possible northern contact.
Castilian New World bases lost or isolated; Portuguese Vestigium-bearing Conquistadores.

canon_sources.title: Vol.II - TFAM - Editor Choice
anchors: Beckett: ruined England requires sustained protection and logistics; no viable current restoration.
Duarte at Santiago; Lourenço at Tagus; Galicia campaign; Rouge exile to Poland.
Wallace killed by Edward only in the alternate-world memory, NOT the main timeline.

canon_sources.title: Vol.III - TFAM - Editor Choice
anchors: Madrid council: Rouge crowned in Kraków, official Habsburg–Polish state name, conditional Convergence Clause, Danes witness, ongoing Novgorod war.
Portuguese truce, ransom and repatriation; Duarte prisoner, Lourenço safe conduct.
Lourenço: Portuguese 1704–1705 operations in England, commander exceeded orders and remains in the New World.
Timothy Beaumont awarded Military Grand Cross and Nueve, retains English identity while serving Castilian.
Gibraltar: Edward and Beckett promise future restoration, not present reconquest.

newly_authored_under_user_authorization.habsburg_poland: Pre-1716 territorial coalition and details of the eastern political refuge; retain source-established Rouge coronation.
newly_authored_under_user_authorization.novgorod_union: 1478 Moscow annexation reversed; enduring city union, elected Pyotr Romanov with centralized military reforms; Finland conquest follows existing map.
newly_authored_under_user_authorization.danes_kingdom: Margrete I and Kalmar foundation shifted three centuries later to 1697, unified northern crown; Finland loss follows map; coalition and treaty witness anchored in novel.
newly_authored_under_user_authorization.scotland_ireland_union: Formal Scottish–Irish compact, councils, capital and guard units; Wallace and Inverness taken from main timeline.
newly_authored_under_user_authorization.england_ruins: Expository connective tissue and presentation of Timothy as survivor representative, not ruler of English ruins.
newly_authored_under_user_authorization.new_portuguese_empire: Court transfer to Rio advanced from real-history 1808; Council and named commanders from novel, existing coastal map retained.
